newsitem.title: USA: TRC Cos expects "slight net loss" in Q3.
newsitem.headline: TRC Cos expects "slight net loss" in Q3.

text.p: TRC Cos Inc said on Wednesday that it expects a small decrease in net service revenue and a "slight net loss" for its third quarter ended March 31, 1997.
TRC, an environmental engineering firm, said it has departed from its usual practice of not about commenting on financial results due to the company's two top executives resigning on April 1.
In last year's third quarter the company reported a loss of $455,068, or $0.06 a share, on sales of $19.4 million.
TRC said on April 1 that chairman and chief executive Vincent Rocco and president Bruce Cowen have resigned.

The company is negotiating an agreement with Rocco and Cowen about repaying the company for the benefits they obtained in exercising TRC stock options that were not authorized by the company's board and certain other reimbursements to the company, TRC said.
